courses_intro_video_source.name: courses_intro_video_source
courses_intro_video_source.value:
("courses"."intro_video_type" is null and "courses"."intro_video_url" is null and "courses"."intro_video_s3_key" is null)
       or ("courses"."intro_video_type" = 'external' and "courses"."intro_video_url" is not null and "courses"."intro_video_s3_key" is null)
       or ("courses"."intro_video_type" = 'uploaded' and "courses"."intro_video_s3_key" is not null and "courses"."intro_video_url" is null)

lessons_exactly_one_parent.name: lessons_exactly_one_parent
lessons_exactly_one_parent.value: ("lessons"."course_module_id" is not null) <> ("lessons"."ruta_module_id" is not null)

lessons_video_source.name: lessons_video_source
lessons_video_source.value:
("lessons"."video_type" is null and "lessons"."video_url" is null and "lessons"."video_s3_key" is null)
       or ("lessons"."video_type" = 'external' and "lessons"."video_url" is not null and "lessons"."video_s3_key" is null)
       or ("lessons"."video_type" = 'uploaded' and "lessons"."video_s3_key" is not null and "lessons"."video_url" is null)

submissions_exactly_one_context.name: submissions_exactly_one_context
submissions_exactly_one_context.value: ("submissions"."course_id" is not null) <> ("submissions"."ruta_module_id" is not null)

submissions_exactly_one_author.name: submissions_exactly_one_author
submissions_exactly_one_author.value: ("submissions"."student_id" is not null) <> ("submissions"."group_id" is not null)

submissions_grade_has_scale_and_author.name: submissions_grade_has_scale_and_author
submissions_grade_has_scale_and_author.value: "submissions"."grade" is null or ("submissions"."grading_mode" is not null and "submissions"."graded_by" is not null and "submissions"."graded_at" is not null)

submissions_review_mode_has_no_grade.name: submissions_review_mode_has_no_grade
submissions_review_mode_has_no_grade.value: "submissions"."grading_mode" is distinct from 'review' or "submissions"."grade" is null

calendar_events_target_matches_type.name: calendar_events_target_matches_type
calendar_events_target_matches_type.value:
("calendar_events"."type" = 'open_learning_sync' and "calendar_events"."course_id" is not null and "calendar_events"."laboratory_id" is null)
       or ("calendar_events"."type" in ('ruta_impacto','mentoria') and "calendar_events"."course_id" is null)

communication_resources_source_matches_t.name: communication_resources_source_matches_type
communication_resources_source_matches_t.value:
("communication_resources"."type" = 'file' and "communication_resources"."s3_key" is not null and "communication_resources"."url" is null)
       or ("communication_resources"."type" = 'link' and "communication_resources"."url" is not null and "communication_resources"."s3_key" is null)
